label: What a root's seated ESSENCE_6 condition excludes, its seat's determination REQUIRES_LACK_1
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred (TRANSFER_1, REQUIRES_LACK_1): for every actual concrete root r at w, every ESSENCE_6 condition C of r's own nature seated in a real constituent k of r that realizes some determination of r holds at every admissible profile q containing r's determinations in which no determination of r realized by k requires, as such, the lack of some members of q. Read contrapositively (classically): where such a seated condition fails at an admissible extension q, some determination of r that its seat realizes requires, as such and so in every bearer, the joint lack of some members of q. A seat that realizes no determination of r is exempt. Under constitutive simplicity, REAL and ESSE it is equivalent to own-nature carriage as such (unityTransferOfOwnCarriage with ownCarriageFromUnity), so its warrant at a simple root is that of carriage; on the open family with the necessity direction of member grounding no requirement relation lets a simple root that lacks noesis by a clause of its nature meet it (simpleUnityCarriageMap, clause 4).
